-- Untrusted names must be single plain file names inside `notes`.
-- Rejects empty names, absolute paths, separators, and "..".
is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool =
  post out == False or name.char_count() > 0
  ex is_plain_name("notes.txt") == True
  ex is_plain_name("../secret") == False
  if name.char_count() == 0
    return False
  if name.split("/").len() > 1 or name.split("\\").len() > 1
    return False
  if name.split("..").len() > 1
    return False
  True

-- Returns the text of `notes/name`. Unsafe names, missing files, and
-- unreadable files all give "". Only `fs` narrowed to `notes` is touched.
read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs =
  pre name.char_count() >= 0
  post is_plain_name(name) == True or out == ""
  ex read_note("missing.txt") == ""
  ex read_note("../secret") == ""
  if is_plain_name(name) == False
    return ""
  var text = ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    text = fs.read(name) else ""
  text

test_is_plain_name() =
  assert is_plain_name("notes.txt") == True
  assert is_plain_name("") == False
  assert is_plain_name("../secret") == False
  assert is_plain_name("a/b") == False

test_read_note() uses fs =
  assert read_note("missing.txt") == ""
  assert read_note("../secret") == ""
